name: Orca
tagline: Type letters on a grid; they become a music sequencer.
description:
A two-dimensional livecoding machine in one GIF. Close it, come back — the same cells are still running.

Open it and a tiny program is already playing a C in this browser. D bangs every 4 frames, * is the bang, :04C is the note. MIDI hardware is optional; without a device you still hear it.

On a phone the pad under the grid types the same operators. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend jams on the same canvas.

An unofficial port of Orca by Hundredrabbits. Same operators, same canvas. OSC and UDP stay silent here; they needed a native socket.
